[ASSISTANT_SAID] Common spices used in Indian cuisine include turmeric, cumin, coriander, cardamom, mustard seeds, fenugreek, and garam masala.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] Turmeric is used to add color and flavor to curries, rice dishes, and chutneys.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] Cumin is used in roasted form for earthy flavor and ground form for nutty taste in curries.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] Coriander's ground seeds are used in spice blends, and its leaves are used as a garnish.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] Cardamom is used in sweets, desserts, biryanis, curries, and tea.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] Mustard seeds are used for tempering and add a pungent flavor.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] Fenugreek is used in curries, lentil dishes, and chutneys, and has medicinal properties.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] Garam Masala is a blend of spices including cinnamon, cardamom, cloves, and cumin, added to biryanis, curries, and soups.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] Spices are incorporated into dishes at different stages of cooking: some at the beginning, some for tempering, and some as garnish.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] Recipe recommendations include Chicken Tikka Masala, Vegetable Korma, Dal Makhani, Aloo Gobi, and Chai Tea.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] Chicken Tikka Masala features chicken marinated in yoghurt and spices, simmered in a creamy tomato sauce.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] Vegetable Korma features a medley of vegetables in a coconut milk-based sauce flavored with cardamom and coriander.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] Dal Makhani features black lentils cooked with spices and finished with cream.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] Aloo Gobi features potatoes and cauliflower cooked with cumin, turmeric, and ground coriander.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] Chai Tea features black tea simmered with spices like cardamom and cinnamon, sweetened with milk and sugar.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] Additional recipe recommendations include Butter Chicken, Samosas, Tandoori Chicken, Chana Masala, and Biryani.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] Butter Chicken features chicken marinated in yoghurt and spices, simmered in a creamy tomato sauce.
